source_sentences: The adult minimum wage for employees aged 20 and over, paid by all employers in Larrow, is $12 an hour from January 1, Year 2 and $14 an hour from January 1, Year 3.
The bill was introduced in December of Year 0 and passed in March of Year 1.
The State Labor Department enforces the Act through complaint-driven investigations, with about 40 investigators; remedies are back pay plus an equal amount in damages, and workers may sue.
Employers may pay employees under 20 at least 85% of the adult minimum: $10.20 in Year 2 and $11.90 in Year 3.

context: About 15% of Larrow workers earn under $12 and about 22% under $14.
The neighboring state of Dorran keeps a $10 minimum.
